title: The Autopsy of Bellwether Lane
author: Orsen Montrose
blurb: Mirabel Okonkwo, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
